name: tool-block
opens_with: (/voice to clear the boot notice, then an agent script)
notes: Tool blocks are a distinct render path (render_tool_items_lines) with four status colours (Queued / Running / Done / Error) and a 3-line output preview — exactly the kind of thing the style baseline exists for and the text dump cannot see. The script leads with a `user` event because build_transcript_turns starts a turn only at a Role::User message and render_messages partitions tool blocks onto a turn: without it the tool state populates and paints nothing.
